Paragraph: "The flowers drop from the branches in steady streams, covering the path like a woven carpet of white and red..."
Situation/Problem_Faced: Walking on paths covered by falling colorful blossoms.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Rama observes the carpeted forest paths created by fallen flowers.
Outcome/Resolution: He focuses on visual patterns during their journey.

Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Emotional Regulation: Path Focus, Mindful Walking, Visual Grounding

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Pushpa-Vrishti (Shower of flowers honoring the righteous path)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Fallen flowers carpeting the path symbolize nature honoring the steps of those walking the path of Dharma.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Mindful walking: focusing on physical path details to ground the mind during movement.
